column2: Step 1: Identify our target persona for your ad.
column3: Step 2: Research creators & influencers that make content for those people.
column4: Step 3: Study the top-performing content from those creators to see which kinds of videos get the most engagement & what kind of messaging they use: (YouTube thumbnails, YouTube titles, YouTube videos, TikTok hooks, TikTok trends, Instagram Reels, Instagram Bios, etc.)
column5: Step 4: Create our content & craft ads with those ideas in mind as you already know it will resonate with our avatar
